final_answer: On the existing interactive arf console (pid 65072), greeting <- 'hi'; print(greeting) ran and printed [1] "hi".
notes: The open console was interactive arf pid 65072 (Windows Terminal title Arf (R)), which I did not start and which had no IPC. A headless arf pid 46908 was listed once, then disappeared; arf ipc eval --pid 46908 returned SESSION_NOT_FOUND. I did not start, shut down, or kill that process. I attached to pid 65072 and sent the R line through its console input. The screen buffer then showed the command and [1] "hi". An earlier screen read printed diagnostic text onto that console display and did not execute as R. No second R was started, Rscript was not used, and no process was shut down or killed.
